task: book a hotel room online (Booking.com, Expedia, hotel brand sites): search destination and dates, compare properties and rates, pick a room and rate plan, enter guest and payment details, book; complete when the reservation confirmation with dates and a confirmation number is on screen. Surface pinned: a hotel-booking website or app. Variants: Airbnb-style stays that require host approval, booking flights, and cancelling an existing reservation do not belong.
